page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY CPU clocked at 2.5 GHz, it features 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled to deliver 16 vCPUs. The instance is paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 4.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. CPU cache specifications include 32 KB L1d per core, 1.0 MB L2 per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. Supported instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI. The server includes no local storage or GPUs and provides a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

In synthetic benchmark evaluations, single-threaded processing presents a throughput constraint, as evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1106.79 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1001.0, both residing in the lower quarter of tested cloud servers. Single-threaded gzip compression at 19.04 GB/sec also lands in the lower performance percentile. However, multi-core scaling compensates for lower per-thread output. Multi-core evaluations show solid mid-tier performance with a stress-ng score of 11798.08, a PassMark CPU score of 13055.33, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaching 56.62 GB/sec. Uncached memory bandwidth reaches 75.86 GB/sec for reads and 55.65 GB/sec for writes.

Providing a balanced resource distribution of 4 GB memory per vCPU without bundled local storage fees, the hardware profile delivers steady mid-range efficiency for multi-threaded server execution. Application-level benchmarks reflect consistent throughput, including static web serving at 9.98 GB/sec and 11.35 million Redis SET operations per second. Prompt processing for small 135M parameter LLMs reaches 827.7 tokens per second. Given its lower single-threaded scores alongside balanced multi-core metrics, this server type is suitable for general-purpose application hosting, containerized microservices, Redis caching layers, and batch database operations.
